--dry-run.rationale: No effect on read operation.

--force.rationale: Command lists task lists; --force means force refresh the listing, not a destructive action.

tasks lists list.rationale: Lists available task lists; only inspects state.

--dry-run.rationale: No effect on read operation.

--force.rationale: Dumps raw API response as JSON for inspection; --force means force refetch, not a destructive action.

tasks raw.rationale: Dumps raw JSON API response for a task; only inspects and displays data.

--dry-run.rationale: Prints intended state change without modifying.

--force.rationale: Skips confirmation but result is reversible state change.

tasks undo.rationale: Marks a task as needing action (incomplete); modifies state but reversible via tasks done.

--dry-run.rationale: Prints intended changes without modifying.

--force.rationale: Skips confirmation but result is still task modification.

tasks update.rationale: Updates task properties; modifies remote state but bounded and reversible.

--dry-run.rationale: No effect on read operation.

--force.rationale: Time utilities group command; --force has no destructive semantics in a time utility context.

time.rationale: Time utilities subcommand group; displays help information without modifying state.

--dry-run.rationale: No effect on read operation.

--force.rationale: Displays current time; --force means force recalculate/refresh, not a destructive action.

time now.rationale: Shows current time; only displays information without modifying state.

--dry-run.rationale: Prints intended upload without making changes.

--force.rationale: Skips confirmation but result is still file upload.

upload.rationale: Uploads a file to Google Drive; creates remote resource but bounded and reversible via Drive deletion.

--dry-run.rationale: Remains read-only; there are no changes to preview or skip on a profile-display command.

--force.rationale: Shows user profile; --force means force refresh profile data, not a destructive action.

whoami.rationale: Displays authenticated user's profile information without modifying state.
